module: Node "Route Position" (once_instant). Gives the position along a route at a given distance ahead. Inputs: navgraphRoute (type navgraphPath), distance. Outputs: pos (vec3), dirVec (segment direction), n1 and n2 (segment nodes). Uses gameplay/route/route.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

onNodeReset.desc: Creates a new route object (local variable of the file, shared between instances).

workOnce.desc: Initializes the route with route:setupPathMultiWaypoints, advances by distance with route:stepAhead and writes n1, n2, pos and dirVec (normalized direction from n1 to n2).
